title: Version exit concierge and comms orchestration for retiring legacy model tags
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Objective: coordinate a staged, low-friction exit for legacy model tags (legacy-v1/*) used by hosted and dedicated customers. Deliverables: a customer-facing migration concierge flow, pre-built client migration scripts, tenant-safe rollout gates, coordinated release notes and email cadence, automated compatibility checks that run during cutover windows, and a post-retirement monitor dashboard. This ticket owns cross-team orchestration and the comms schedule — not the low-level SDK changes (ENG) or the UI work (DES), but will track and unblock them.
success_metrics: 1) <25% of active legacy API calls remain by final decommission date; 2) <2% customer-reported regressions after cutover; 3) migration-concierge assisted migrations completed for top 50 customers within SLA; 4) zero unplanned rollbacks to legacy tag after final cutover.
acceptance_criteria: Published migration concierge page and intake form (docs.redwood.ai/migrate-legacy-v1)
Automated compatibility test suite added to CI and nightly jobs (PR merged)
Email cadence documented and scheduled in Outreach/Intercom with templates
Design-approved UX for tenant-level feature flag to opt-in/opt-out during phased rollout
Runbook and rollback steps verified in simulated cutover drill
milestones: Week 1: Finalize migration concierge scope, identify top 200 legacy callers and map owners
Week 2: Deliver migration scripts and sample prompts, align SDK breaking change notes
Week 3: Publish docs + self-serve checklist; start targeted outreach to high-risk customers
Week 4: Execute limited canary with 10 pilot customers and track regressions
Week 5: Open gradual platform-wide gating and begin automated redirects for tolerant clients
Week 6: Full decommission of legacy tag, post-cutover monitoring and 2-week support window
comms_timeline: T-28d: High-level announcement blog + top-customer heads-up
T-21d: Detailed migration guide and sample code snippets posted; intercom segments created
T-14d: Account exec outreach starts for top 50 customers; schedule concierge sessions
T-7d: Reminder email + changelog entry in release notes; public deprecation banner in Console
T-1d: Final notice to active keys using legacy tags; automated grace redirects enabled
D-day: Decommission executed; status page updated; support rotation on standby
D+3d, D+7d, D+14d: Progress summaries and postmortem cadence emails
risks: High-volume clients embed legacy tag in serverless functions and will be hard to track
SDKs with long release cycles (on-prem customers) may not upgrade in time
Inaccurate telemetry may undercount active legacy usage leading to surprise impact
Automated redirects could mask regressions and delay root-cause fixes
mitigations: Prioritize account-exec outreach for top 50 by token-volume; offer concierge migration sessions
Ship lightweight runtime shim that proxies legacy tag to new tag with warning headers for 30 days
Add retroactive logging hooks for legacy-taged requests to S3 for 90-day visibility
Hold a pre-cutover drill with SRE and Customer Support to validate rollback paths
open_tasks: ENG: finish and merge compatibility CI jobs (ENG-94822)
DES: create in-console deprecation banner and migration CTA (DES-2048)
DX: finalize migration concierge intake form and calendar links
GTM: craft email templates and schedule Outreach sequences
Legal: review customer notice language for contractual obligations
Support: prepare FAQ and escalation matrix
